name: Pathfinder
description: Predictive path-simulation autoplay bot. Simulates your cube's trajectory ahead of it and jumps before it hits hazards. Experimental.

lookahead.name: Lookahead Distance
lookahead.description: How far ahead (in pixels) the simulator scans for hazards

sim-time.name: Simulation Time (s)
sim-time.description: How many seconds into the future the path is simulated

gravity.name: Gravity (px/s^2)
gravity.description: Downward acceleration used by the simulator. Community estimate for cube mode is ~1185 (39.5 blocks * 30 px). Tune to your GD version if needed.

jump-velocity.name: Jump Velocity (px/s)
jump-velocity.description: Upward impulse applied when the bot decides to jump. Community estimate; tune to your GD version if needed.

move-speed.name: Move Speed (px/s)
move-speed.description: Horizontal speed assumed by the simulator. GD's normal cube speed is community-estimated around 311 px/s (10.4 blocks). Tune to your GD version if needed.

show-path.name: Show Predicted Path
show-path.description: Draw the simulated trajectory on the level (green = chosen path, red = predicted to hit a hazard)
